<thought>The spectrum shows a clear isotopic envelope with peaks spaced by ~1 Da and decreasing intensities (M, M+1, M+2, …). This pattern matches the natural 13C distribution and does not display the characteristic 3:1 (Cl) or 1:1 (Br) M+2 patterns, nor the ~4 % M+2 of sulfur. Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from the isotope distribution.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
